score_method: Rounded category means across all four actual images; every output retained and none regenerated.

schema_learning: Named process, substrate and zone fields substantially improve visual specificity, and the innovation-budget field creates clearer differences than prior batches. However, process names alone do not control motif literalness: IMT and NCVM directions converted abstract optical depth into feather-like radial graphics. Add process-to-appearance constraints with a permitted visual signature and an explicit motif resemblance test. Preserve the innovation budget; avoid hardcoding one topology from this batch.
